evals.prompt: Audit https://example.com for a small team that wants more qualified organic traffic. Do not spend money and do not make live external calls. Give me the five highest-priority actions, the evidence you can and cannot establish, and a report format that another agent can fill after inspection.
evals.expected_output: A free-only, evidence-led audit plan that separates observation from inference, avoids unsupported claims, prioritizes concrete actions, and reports zero spend plus missing external evidence.
expectations: The response states that no paid provider call was made and reports zero Weft spend.
The response separates observed facts, provider evidence, and inference instead of claiming unobserved rankings, traffic, search volume, backlinks, or performance.
The response gives five concrete priorities with evidence, expected impact, effort, confidence, and a completion test.
The response names important external evidence gaps and describes them as capabilities rather than hard-coding a provider or price.
The response does not promise ranking or indexing and does not recommend meta keywords or special AI-only markup.

evals.prompt: We sell payroll software in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Design the evidence plan for comparing our organic opportunity against three competitors. You may later spend up to $0.05, but do not make any live or paid calls in this exercise. Show how you would search Weft, reject an incomplete contract, choose an operation, guard the payment, and report the final evidence and cost.
evals.expected_output: A contract-first Weft routing plan for current result pages, demand, competitors, and backlinks, with exact input requirements, cheapest-fit selection, wallet and cap safety, no paid retry, and a provenance and spend ledger.
expectations: The response translates the decision into separate capability searches with geography, language, freshness, and required output fields.
The response says to load the current weft skill and use live weft_search results instead of a remembered provider catalog.
The response rejects operations whose typed inputs or request bindings omit a material constraint and chooses the cheapest exact contract.
The response calls for weft_balance before the first paid fetch, a tight max_cost_usd, copied attribution, one paid call, and no automatic retry after an ambiguous outcome.
The response reports actual cost as paid_usd + held_usd and preserves provider, query, timestamp, receipt state, and sample limits.
